project.oneSentence: Four TF2 classes fortify an arena, then survive an escalating skeleton horde cued by Left 4 Dead 2's horde warning music.

requiredGames.role: The game the player launches; supplies classes, buildings, arena play, zombies, and stock assets.
Required sound source; its horde warning cue is copied from the player's installed game at launch.

arena.worldMaterialPolicy: reference stock TF2 materials from the player's installed game; embed no Valve textures/models
arena.multiplayerState: four-player target selected by user; host/join and actual capacity still require a two-instance test
